account:
Today I have been following my appointments: morning office business, a market walk, lunch at home, and afternoon town accounts. The treasury held two stacks of 64 emeralds, which I left untouched. I am now preparing to go to tea at three with the neighbour, who personally confirmed the cottage at (16, -60, 105), east of the ferry landing. The secretary had independently checked dockside cottages and asked three warehouse workers but could not verify the address; my attempted reply explaining the confirmation was not heard. That seems an unresolved communication issue rather than evidence of anything suspicious.

The baker has been active: townsfolk reported seeing wheat at the bakery and sacks of bread at the inn and market, and I saw bread placed in the bakery stall at 10:50. This looks consistent with baking, delivery, and restocking, though I do not know the purpose of each trip. I heard a distant shout from the baker during lunch but could not understand it. A lantern appeared near a town-hall table at (-58, -60, 31); I did not see who placed it or learn why. Several townsfolk said they had no news, and nobody has brought a definite concern to my attention. I have not observed enough to conclude there is an unusual scheme or emergency.
